entity:HTTPADAPTER.title: HTTPADAPTER
entity:HTTPADAPTER.description:
HTTPADAPTER refers to the externally defined `HTTPAdapter` class from the Requests library, typically imported from `requests.adapters` or a local `.adapters` module. It serves as the default transport adapter for HTTP and HTTPS session connections and is instantiated as `HTTPAdapter()` when mounting default adapters for the `http://` and `https://` URL prefixes.

HTTPADAPTER can also be configured with connection-pool or retry options, including constructions such as `HTTPAdapter(max_retries=retries)`, before being mounted on a session. It provides adapter functionality such as `proxy_headers`, and it is used directly in tests and other visible code. The class is also documented and used as the base class for specialized adapters such as `Ssl3HttpAdapter`.

Although HTTPADAPTER is imported and referenced repeatedly—including for session mounting, retry configuration, proxy handling, subclassing, and tests—its actual implementation is not visible in the provided material.
